2486-2829-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-2829-4694-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

4213-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4213-4687-5115.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

710-728-1703.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-1417-4867-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-1417-4867-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Bridge from Below triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3490-4716-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4716-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2921-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4241-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1414-6965.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1661-2478-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1661-2478-2854-4574.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4316-5043-5078-5231.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

413-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

647-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

195-2092-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
195-2092-3371.description:
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting Codie.
Holding priority, activate Codie by paying at most {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve Chain Stasis, untapping Codie and causing you to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, with the copy targeting Codie.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may choose not to copy Chain Stasis and cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

2744-4659-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2744-4659-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelvaite creature token.
The Triskelvaite enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Triskelvaite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-4289-5251.notablePrerequisites: Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4289-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

141-624-2302-4707.notablePrerequisites: Any color besides "Blue" chosen with Painter's Servant.
141-624-2302-4707.description:
Cast Obscura Charm by paying {W}{U}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, copying Obscura Charm.
Resolve the copy of Obscura Charm, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Naru Meha.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, copying Obscura Charm.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2694-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2694-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Gavony Unhallowed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
